notes.title: The Demo for Cats & Castles is Live During Strategy Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're happy to announce [i]Cats & Castles[/i] is taking part in Steam Strategy Fest with a playable demo.

We're excited to be sharing a playable demo to the public for the first time. We hope you enjoy what you see in this early stage as we keep developing the game. If you like it, we would appreciate wishlists and follows as they help us out a lot!

Looking forward to all the feedback on the demo! Stay tuned for more updates!

Steam Strategy Fest runs August 28 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7) to September 4 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7).
